title: Terms of Service
version_or_date: Undated: no version or last-updated date printed on the Terms (site footer reads © 2025 Protege Health, Inc.)

parties.licensor: Protege Health Inc. (Delaware), licensing Datasets it makes available; upstream data licensors stand behind it and are unnamed (their names are Protege Confidential Information)
parties.licensee: Customer: the entity or person accessing the Service (model builders), limited to its Authorized Users

permitted_use.value: Customer may view Datasets on the Platform (after an Access Fee) to decide on purchases, and use licensed Datasets only for the specific use cases in the Agreement / Statement of Work; every other use is prohibited.

ai_training_rights.value: Grants training of ML/AI models the Customer owns or licenses, solely for SOW-authorised purposes; fine-tuning, evaluation and model outputs are not mentioned; synthetic data generation is barred; redistribution, sublicensing and commercialising the Datasets or derivative works to third parties are barred (read literally this could reach trained models).

field_of_use.value: Narrow field of use set per deal: only the use cases/authorised purposes in the signed Statement of Work; no building of a competing service.

term_duration.value: No fixed term stated (set by SOW); either party may terminate for uncured material breach (30 days) or on 30 days' notice for insolvency; Protege may suspend or terminate access on a reasonable belief of breach or security risk.

exclusivity.value: Licence is non-exclusive under the standard Terms (a SOW could override).

sublicensing.value: Non-transferable and non-sublicensable; no resale, rental, lease or third-party access to Datasets; assignment by Customer needs Protege's consent.

derivatives_and_model_outputs.value: No derivative works using Dataset data without a signed SOW; no synthetic datasets or artifacts; derivative works may not be commercialised to third parties; ownership of trained models or outputs is not addressed beyond 'models owned or licensed by Customer'.

audit_rights.value: Protege and its licensors may audit the Customer on prior written notice (records, systems, interviews) to check use and deletion; Customer remedies and may bear audit costs.

deletion_on_termination.value: Customer must fully delete or return the Datasets on termination or expiration (stated inside the audit clause), verifiable by audit.

warranties_by_provider.value: Protege (licensor) warrants only its authority to contract; it disclaims all other warranties including non-infringement, and supplies Datasets as is, with no accuracy guarantee.

indemnity.value: One-way: Customer indemnifies Protege and its licensors for third-party claims from Customer's unlawful use or breach, uncapped; Protege gives no indemnity to the Customer.

liability_cap.value: Each party's aggregate liability capped at fees Customer paid in the 12 months before the event; indirect/consequential damages excluded; Customer's indemnity is carved out of both.

payment_and_revenue_share.value: Customer pays an Access Fee to use the Platform to browse Datasets; dataset prices and any provider revenue share are not stated in the Terms.

governing_law.value: Delaware and US federal law, CISG excluded; exclusive venue in state and federal courts of New Castle County, Delaware.

prohibited_uses.value: No illegal or fraudulent use, no re-identification, no synthetic data, no sale/sublicence/distribution or third-party access, no derivative works without SOW, no competing service, no reverse engineering.

unknowns.note: No clause on consent, releases or privacy authorisations of people in the data, by Protege or its upstream licensors; the only warranty is mutual authority to contract, and non-infringement is disclaimed. Re-identification is prohibited.
No mechanism for data-subject erasure requests or recalling items from copies a Customer already holds; deletion is required only at termination or expiration of the Agreement.
No clause on how Protege may change these Terms; the page carries no version or last-updated date.
No territorial scope stated; may be set in the Statement of Work.
No attribution requirement; dataset licensor names are treated as Protege Confidential Information.

The Terms contain no clause banning use of a person's likeness, voice or identity (e.g. deepfakes or face generation); the only related restriction is the ban on re-identification. Any such ban would sit in a Statement of Work, which is not public.
The Statement of Work, which sets the authorised purposes, pricing and any overrides, is not published.
